name: Default
shortDescription: Krokiet, the current Czkawka GUI, streamed to the browser to find duplicates, similar images, empty folders and other unneeded files.

alerts.message: Sign in with the WEB_AUTHENTICATION_USERNAME and generated WEB_AUTHENTICATION_PASSWORD values from the environment. Krokiet only scans files inside the container: upload them to /storage with the file manager (folder icon in the web control panel), then add /storage as an included directory.
